name: Storybook Stickman
best_for: Narrated fables · simple characters with rich settings
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Style/medium: A refined STORYBOOK STICKMAN film illustration: deliberately simple, appealing stick-figure people inside a softly detailed illustrated station. Woman and father have clean round light faces, tiny expressive eyes/mouths, simple black bob/silver-hair marks, thin black LINE arms and legs, minimal flat indigo/olive clothing shapes and terracotta scarf accent. Their silhouettes must remain unmistakably stick figures, with no filled anatomical limbs or realistic faces. Show the envelope as a small clear cream shape near the woman's simple hand. The bench, station and hills are tastefully hand-painted with soft depth and selective detail, not photographic microtexture. The contrast between simple figures and a richer storybook environment is deliberate. Elegant poses, readable emotion, uncluttered staging; no crude doodles, extra limbs or busy cobblestones.

Asset: one polished full-frame style reference for story-film production, wide landscape 16:9. Aim for a clear emotionally readable movie still, not a decorative poster.
Scene: a quiet fictional countryside railway platform in soft late-afternoon daylight. A cream plaster station with sage-green window trim and a simple timber canopy recedes into the background; one wooden bench at the right, a restrained glimpse of green hills beyond. Keep the setting spacious and uncluttered; no crowds or train or signs.
Story moment: a young adult woman has come home and offers her elderly father one small plain cream envelope. She stands at the left facing right; he sits on the bench at the right facing her. Their eyes meet with warm, restrained, relieved smiles. She has warm medium-brown skin, a short wavy dark bob, an indigo jacket over an ivory shirt, a muted terracotta scarf, dark trousers and simple brown boots. He has warm medium-brown skin, short silver hair, an olive cardigan over a cream shirt and charcoal trousers. The envelope is held naturally by the woman at waist height; his hands rest comfortably on his knees. Exactly two people and one envelope. No dramatic reaching hands or complicated finger gestures.
Composition: medium-wide eye-level two-shot, natural perspective, readable faces and silhouettes; woman visible head to boots, father fully visible seated, both comfortably inside frame. Subjects occupy the central area with breathing room at the edges. Layer foreground, characters and a simplified background clearly. Keep the bottom strip relatively calm for possible subtitles, but add no text.
Color and light: tasteful warm ivory, sage green, indigo and one terracotta accent; gentle daylight, readable skin tones, balanced contrast, softly warm highlights, subtle cooler distant hills. No heavy orange/teal grade, muddy shadows, blown-out bloom, fluorescent colors, visual clutter or aggressive texture. Preserve calm hopeful emotion. All foreground and background objects must follow the selected medium.
Output: ONE finished image, preferably 2048x1152 or another native wide 16:9 size supported by the tool. No panels, borders, captions, lettering, logos, watermark, layout guide or interface. This is an illustrative global treatment example, not a specific user's story canon.
review_notes: Inspected the actual user-supplied PNG: readable rounded faces and expressions, simple black line arms/hands, clothed filled legs and bodies, a clear envelope and detailed warmly lit station. Full figures and feet fit inside frame; no unwanted lettering or conspicuous artifacts at reviewed scale. This is the exact hybrid the user requested, not a pure all-line stick-figure construction. The prior prompt-fidelity concern remains documented in selection_history.
source_filename_role: Original built-in output provenance. The selected file is the user-supplied PNG encoding of that output; decoded RGB pixels match exactly, while file-byte hashes differ.
description: Simple faces and black line arms with clothed bodies in a richly detailed storybook world.

selection_basis.scope: Include this exact example in the global visual preference library.

selection_history.notes: Study not selected: line arms are present but textured filled legs and naturalistic faces/background do not meet the intended clean stickman construction. Excluded from the lean primary film chooser; custom simple-figure directions remain allowed.
